author: Universal Pictures
description: 12 HOURS CAN CHANGE EVERYTHING... Unless you're one of our Universal Below-the-Line Traineeship participants. Then it becomes weeks of hands-on experience, lasting connections, and a studio credit. By offering trainees invaluable hands-on experience, this group of emerging talent contributed to key areas such as Grip, Wardrobe and Sustainability. They gained essential skills while working alongside industry professionals on a major production in New York.
title: Universal Below-The-Line Traineeship | One Night Only
